description: Read a Discord channel's recent messages, newest first, for context — what members are saying before you write. Other people’s text needs Discord’s Message Content intent; a message Discord withholds is marked contentHidden. Free.

before.description: page back from this message id

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

channel.description: channel id or #name; unset = the default channel

name: read_discord_channel
title: Read a Discord channel
